# Security Policy

## Supported Scopes & Repositories

| Scope / Target | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `*.thenudasahas.site` | :white_check_mark: In-Scope |
| `@thenudasahas2008/*` | :white_check_mark: In-Scope |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We prioritize responsible and coordinated vulnerability disclosure (CVD). If you have identified a security vulnerability, issue, or potential risk across any open-source tools or connected endpoints, please notify us:

- **Primary Contact**: [sahas.thenu@gmail.com](mailto:sahas.thenu@gmail.com)
- **Encryption**: GPG / PGP communications supported
- **Response SLA**: Initial triage within 24 hours
- **Safe Harbor Pledge**: We will not pursue legal action against researchers acting in good faith within authorized testing boundaries.
